caption: The drawing features two representations of the same sleeveless waistcoat: one is a detailed, colored front view, and the other is a simple, uncolored line drawing of the back. The waistcoat in the front view is cream or pale yellow with colorful embroidered floral motifs in pink, blue, green, and a touch of red, distributed across the entire surface. The embroidery pattern includes delicate flowers with leaves and stems, and blue ribbon-like decorations. The waistcoat has a high, rounded collar and buttons down the front, which are illustrated with buttonholes and small round buttons. There are two angular, flap pockets on each side at the waist, bordered and decorated with the same floral and ribbon embroidery. The edges of the waistcoat, including the armholes, hem, fronts, and pocket flaps, are outlined with a thin, dark line. The adjacent back view is a simple outline sketch, showing the shape and curved seams, but with no color or embellishments. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Waistcoat
